missing_items.item: High-level and low-level requirements with unambiguous acceptance criteria

missing_items.why_required: ETP-T1 records 21 requirement nodes and 0 specification nodes; no negotiated requirement baseline exists for the declared context.

missing_items.item: Verification cases derived from the requirements, not from the source

missing_items.item: MC/DC and object-code coverage where the declared level requires it
missing_items.settling_method: Select the required structural coverage for the declared level, name the instrument, the decision population and the measured result, and run it at the exact artefact.
missing_items.why_required: No MC/DC or object-code coverage record exists. The traceability document states that MC/DC is not measured anywhere and is not claimed.

missing_items.item: A system safety assessment and the DAL it would assign
missing_items.settling_method: Declare a system context with airborne applicability, perform the safety assessment, and record the assigned level. This matrix does not do that.
missing_items.why_required: No system safety assessment exists and no DAL is assigned. The declared context is non-airborne, so this item is named as absent rather than borrowed from another system.

missing_items.item: DO-330 assessment for every tool whose output the argument depends on
missing_items.settling_method: For each tool the argument depends on, record its intended use, qualification basis, version, digest, positive and negative controls, and a DO-330 assessment at the pinned toolchain.
missing_items.why_required: The instrument register is explicitly not a DO-330 qualification, and FRC-0 records 15 candidate provers with 0 admitted because none was tested against the pinned compiler.

missing_items.item: Verification executed on the declared target hardware
missing_items.settling_method: Declare the target hardware and build identity, execute the verification suite there, and bind each result to the target artefact digest.
missing_items.why_required: Every cited record was produced on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu on the development host or in the court container. No target hardware is declared and no cross-target execution exists.

missing_items.item: A complete configuration index for the declared context
missing_items.settling_method: Build a configuration index from source and toolchain through every executed artefact, with a digest per input, and record the uncertifiable items as gaps rather than defaults.
missing_items.why_required: ETP-2 records byte-identical builds at one host, image, toolchain and target, and ETP-T9 classifies 118 of 231 evidence items as UNCERTIFIABLE. No complete index binds every input and artefact of the declared context.

missing_items.item: Independent review and quality assurance by a distinct trust domain
missing_items.settling_method: Name a party outside the project with its own infrastructure and signing identity, have it review the work products, and record the review artefact and its distinctness evidence.
missing_items.why_required: The independence record has 50 assignments, all 50 adjudicated by the author's party, 0 declared parties and 0 external parties; the one asserted independence was refused.

missing_items.item: A DO-333 justification, its assumptions and its proof artefacts
missing_items.settling_method: Write the DO-333 justification for each formal method used, state its assumptions and TCB, and bind each proof artefact to the exact source and binary identity.
missing_items.why_required: No proof artefact exists. ETP-T3 records no discharged refinement edge and FRC-0 records no admitted prover. A bounded test is not a formal result.

missing_items.item: Bounded execution, deadline analysis and worst-case execution time
missing_items.settling_method: Declare the execution-time budget, measure the bound on the target, and record the analysis with its assumptions and its uncovered paths.
missing_items.why_required: No execution-time bound, deadline or WCET analysis exists. A constant-time instrument result is not a WCET result, and the court venue has no PMU.

missing_items.item: Problem reporting and change control under a governing plan
missing_items.settling_method: Establish a problem-report process, bind each change to its impact analysis, and record the change decision and its verification at the new identity.
missing_items.why_required: ETP-T11 records 6 change sets with 0 SATISFIED and status REFUSED. There is machine-readable impact analysis, but no problem-reporting process under a DO-178C plan and no selective proof invalidation because no proof exists.

system_context.evidence_basis: Every record the matrix cites was produced on the development host or in the court container for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; nothing in this repository is bound to an airborne target, an airborne environment or a DAL.

excludes.exclusion: No airborne, embedded or production target hardware is in scope; every cited record is from x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu on the development host or in the court container.
No aircraft, engine or spacecraft installation, environment or lifecycle is claimed; DO-178C is used here as a checklist of objectives, not as an invoked certification basis.
No development assurance level is assigned, proposed or claimed, including DAL A, B, C, D and E.
No airworthiness finding, approval, compliance statement or system-level safety result follows from this matrix, and none is claimed.
Bounded execution, deadline analysis and worst-case execution time are excluded; a constant-time instrument result is not a WCET result.
Environmental qualification, including temperature, vibration, radiation and electromagnetic effects, is excluded.
